pages.title: Otherstone Trader
pages.text: The Otherstone Trader spirit allows to get more $(item)Otherstone$() than using $(item)Spiritfire$().$(br)Thus it is especially efficient if you want to use Otherstone as a building material.$(br)
To trade, drop your offered item next to the trader,$(br)he will pick it up and drop the exchanged item.$(br)
